scope: Remove the C adapter polling-only pass after complete foreign-page validation.
production_delta: Four removed lines in c_abi/provider.rs; first shape/footprint pass, descriptor bound and final publication control check retained.

validation.red_witness: Unchanged production code reports two work units for one raw Float sample; new one-pass assertion fails before loop removal.
validation.publication_controls: All15 combinations of1/17/1024 sample pages: successful publication, cancellation during validation, malformed tail plus cancellation, expired deadline, malformed tail plus deadline; balanced cleanup.
validation.memory_and_io: All recorded memory categories including acquired/released/current/peak, provider calls, fetched/page/output counts and logical sample statistics are equal in every repeated paired case.
validation.work: Successful C queries remove exactly one work unit per fetched sample in all72 configurations.
validation.output: Exact expected Float bits, timestamp, series/point count and surviving raw label bytes asserted; annotation counts compared.

measurement.method: Alternate baseline/candidate process order each round; compile and create control before timed collect. Two query repetitions per process, first excluded from median. Existing callback-error checks run outside timing.

followup_controls.plan: Only the three initial no-deadline cases with ratio above1.05; five alternating paired process blocks,31queries per process, omit first from timing.
followup_controls.conclusion: The three initial slowdowns did not reproduce in any of15 longer paired blocks. Original slower observations remain in the main timings.

limitations: Initial C caller run stopped because its transient-job PATH omitted the installed Clang directory; the failed run is retained and a source-matched follow-up completes both profiles.
C-query elapsed includes generated provider work, evaluation and result construction; it is not isolated adapter CPU.
Shared workstation timings are variable; retain every slower case and all repetitions.
Annotation content is not compared by this benchmark; count equality is not full diagnostic equivalence.
Native C/C++ checks do not establish fresh ARM execution or live DBengine performance.
No raw-page layout, ownership, arithmetic or public ABI change; no claim of whole-goal completion.
